historical_references.reference: Bheeti was a prominent Jat ruler in the 17th century in the Shekhawati region of Rajasthan, India. He is said to have founded the town of Bhiwani which bears his name.
Another reference suggests that Bheeti was a fortified town in the 15th century located in the present-day Haryana state of India. It is mentioned in the chronicles of the Mughal emperor Babur.
